visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and glasses, wearing a blue inner shirt and a green-and-white striped outer shirt, sits at a light-colored wooden table in an indoor restaurant. He looks towards the camera with a neutral expression. In front of him is a large blue-and-white bowl of beef noodles and a small dish of mustard greens. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the bowl of beef noodles. Dark broth with oily surface bubbles is visible. Thick white noodles are being lifted by black chopsticks, and steam rises from the hot dish. A metal spoon sits partially submerged in the soup. (3) The camera returns to the man who now shows a wide-eyed, surprised expression. Animated white radial lines appear around his head as visual emphasis. He holds up a pink 100 NTD bill, smiling broadly at the camera while gesturing with the money. (4) The man uses a metal spoon and black chopsticks to lift multiple pieces of dark, chunky beef from the bowl to demonstrate the quantity. He appears happy and enthusiastic. In the background, another customer in a light blue jacket is visible but out of focus. (5) The man continues to smile and laugh while looking directly into the camera lens, appearing satisfied with his meal. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the scene, highlighting the textures of the food and the man's facial reactions.
